name: Elisa Oyj
summary: Elisa Oyj provides telecommunications, information and communication technology (ICT), and online services in Finland, rest of Europe, and internationally. It operates through two segments: Consumer Customers and Corporate Customers. The company offers consumers with telecommunications and communications services, including fixed and mobile subscriptions, supplementary digital services, cable TV subscriptions, and entertainment services, as well as IT and communication solutions.
